integrity: Attached executable independently recomputes all graph classes, faces and acyclic Morse matchings and verifies census.csv byte-for-byte.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite isomorphism census only for square-sequence length at most six; arbitrary length, infinite recurrence, and symmetry representations not established. Unindexed prior coverage and independent validation remain open.
title: Six-square census for four-robust clique complexes with unrestricted square gluing
